Key ingredients:

  • Rice water  is thought to contain some essential antioxidants, minerals, and vitamins and has often been incorporated into Asian beauty routines with success in toning the skin and improving the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles, and brown spot
  • Niacinamide naturally renews the skin and gives an anti-wrinkle effect. Thanks to its effects, it ensures the unification of skin tone, reduces pores, treats small acne scars. It combats dark pigment spots, stimulates sebum production and reduces redness and irritation. Its properties promote collagen production and protect the skin from UV rays. It is a versatile ingredient that is suitable for all skin types. It moisturises the skin while keeping it matte. Suitable for all skin types.
  • Ceramides are found in the cell membranes of the epidermal layer and are lipidic in nature ( lipid-fat). Ceramides are the perfect solution to regenerative processes due to their unique ability to fuse the gaps between the cells of the outer hair and skin sheath FOR SKIN - helps to restore and moisturise the skin barrier. Without ceramides, the skin would be dry, irritated and itchy. Suitable for dry, sensitive skin.
  • Protein It gives elasticity and firmness to the skin. Fights ageing, fine lines and wrinkles with other ingredients. Thanks to protein we have stronger hair, nails and skin. The most important protein in the skin is Keratin - it forms the surface of the skin, nail and hair. It helps protect the skin barrier.
  • Panthenol moisturizing, anti-inflammatory, healing and has regenerative effects. It strengthens the skin barrier and improves skin elasticity. Thanks to its ability to regenerate cells, it helps with injuries and sunburn. Moisturises and binds moisture to itself. It is suitable for all skin types. 
  • Glycerin hydrate the outer layer of the skin (stratum corneum), improve skin barrier function, provide protection against skin, irritants accelerate wound-healing processes, relieve dry skin may help with psoriasis
  • Allantoin can help with hydration, exfoliation, and skin healing. Allantoin has been shown to increase collagen production in the skin, promoting skin elasticity and wound healing for younger-looking skin. Allantoin is a non-toxic and safe ingredient that can be used with minimal side effects.

Use after cleansing and toning, up to twice daily.

Helpful info for Sunscreen
UVA - Long wave ultraviolet A (UVA) rays penetrate deep into the dermis, the skin's thickest layer and causes premature skin aging, wrinkling and dark spots.
UVB - Short wave ultraviolet B (UVB) rays burn the superficial layers of the skin and is the main cause of sunburn and skin cancer.
PA - More + signs mean longer protection against UVA
SPF - Higher numbers mean longer protection against UVB
